reviews.text: Dr. Feng is outstanding. She will shoot you straight.

My son recommended this Vet because they’re very knowledgeable with French bulldogs.  I travel more than one hour one way for my puppy to be seen at Suburbia North Animal Hospital.  The doctors and the staff are amazing.  We’re happy!!
We’re grateful for your 5-star review! Your feedback means a lot to us, and we hope to continue providing great care for your pet.

Great people, treated my little English Bulldog as if he was their own. Every person we came into contact was just so nice. Also their prices were very reasonable. I love that we can bring all our animals, dogs, cats & bunnies to one veterinarian clinic.
Our Titan had his surgery and they did amazing with our boy.
Thank you for treating Titan like family.

Dr Henry was amazing with our Molly girl her whole life even with her passing early this summer. She hugged and cried with us the whole way. I knew when we adopted our boy Snoopy we had to come back to the best. She is the most compassionate vet we have ever been too. The whole office is amazing and we would recommend to anyone!
I have seen every vet at Suburbia North and they are all exceptional. I trust all of my pets with North Suburbia and have been going there for some time.
Dr.Henry is great and staff too !!! Love Jessica she is great at what she does !!!

Unfortunately, we had to go there to put our fur baby down. The staff and veterinarian were very caring and excellent. They provided us a chance to spend with our dog before and after the procedure. Afterwards they even placed her in a bag with flowers and a very nice note and loaded her in our car, so we could drive her to the crematorium. If you have to go through this with your fur baby, I highly recommend Suburbia.
Mary, your 5-star review means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience. See you and your pet next time!
Great bunch of ladies who really have a passion for our fur babies.
We appreciate the 5-star rating, Dawn! It's wonderful to know you had a positive experience. We hope to see you and your pet again soon!
Thank you, Daniel, for the fantastic rating! We're delighted you had a positive experience at our clinic. See you and your pet soon!
I love this office. I’ve been going here for years now and I can’t say enough good things about the veterinarians and office staff.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Lisa! We're glad you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
The attention and care given to my dog by everyone on the staff is excellent and is greatly appreciated.
The doctors and staff are awesome and so knowledgeable about my Frenchies. They take care of them like I would and give them all the love when we go!

This is a great team! I don’t want my dogs to be “sick” but love taking them to Suburbia North. Everyone is friendly and helpful. My vet (Catherine Henry) is awesome! Very caring and compassionate with all the fur babies in her care. It’s pretty far for me to drive there, but well worth the trip. They are just wonderful group of folks.

I had been taking my dogs to the same veterinary clinic in The Woodlands for over 30 years. After experiencing racism, I made the difficult decision to find a new veterinarian.

This clinic is only about 10 minutes from my home. I will admit that I initially hesitated because the exterior is simple and not heavily landscaped. I'm so glad I listened to my husband not to  judge it by its outside appearance.

From the moment I walked through the door, the atmosphere felt warm, welcoming, and respectful. The staff is polite, professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. It is obvious that they invest their time and resources into providing excellent care for their patients and creating a positive environment for both pets, their families and the employees.

As an African American woman, finding a place where I feel comfortable, respected, and welcomed means a great deal to me. This clinic has given me that. The environment is diverse, inclusive, and professional, and I have been extremely pleased with every interaction.  Harlem is actually blind and was actually relaxed.

This will always be my veterinary clinic, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, high-quality veterinary care.
They always take special care of our 4 leg family members.  They are especially great with help breeding.
Awesome with my Bulldog!!
Doreen, your 5-star rating means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience. Looking forward to your next visit!

I can not say enough amazing things about Dr. Feng, nurses, office staff, etc. Every experience has been nothing but wonderful. Caring, patient, accommodating to each pets specific needs, informative...list goes on and on! They have not only met all my expectations but EXCEEDED them!! We have  finally found our forever vet home!!
Always the kindest caring team♥️
Great doctors and staff. My dogs like them and so do I.
Absolutely love this clinic!!! I tried several others before deciding this one would be my forever go to for all of my babies. I felt very welcomed from the moment I walked into this clinic!.!.!.
Julio, your 5-star rating means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience at our clinic. Looking forward to your next visit!
Thanks for the 4-star rating, Armand! We're happy to have been of service to you and your pet. If you have any suggestions for improvement, we'd love to hear them.

Genuinely the worst costumer service i’ve ever seen in my life. Truly sad, I just went in with a rabbit that was very lethargic and they looked me dead in the face after waiting for 10 minutes and said they could look at my rabbit but not treat him. The secretary claimed no one had called, but there was more than 2 calls with no answer. DO NOT TAKE ANYTHING BUT DOGS AND CATS OR ANY EMERGENCY they will turn you away and gaslight you into believing you are the reason your animal cannot be assessed.

Great Vet Care and Repro Services.  So thankful I found them and they are now caring for my Cavalier King Charles.
Over the past 6 yrs our fur family has grown, Cham, Honey, Luna, and Aria... all of our adult dogs and puppies receive excellent care!
The level of care and compassion at this hospital is at the highest  level!! From Dr. ,the techs and front desk I can't  say thank you enough!!

Suburbia North Animal Hospital is a small place that efficiently handles LOTS of pets and their humans. I’m never unimpressed with the friendly and professional staff and how well they each do their jobs while making everyone feel welcome and served.  Kay McGuire is an excellent doctor who spends time listening to me, asks questions and offers a plan for treating my pups while also offering tips for a happier relationship between me and my pets.  Can’t say enough good things about this place!
Very Nice and knowledgeable staff. Prices are reasonable and fast service. Would come here again. Thanks!
Thank you for your rating, Tania. We're glad you had a positive experience with us. If there's anything more we can do for you and your pet, feel free to reach out.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Henry. She is genuinely one of the best veterinarians I have ever worked with, and I say that as someone who has had pets my entire life.

As a chameleon owner, vet visits can be extremely stressful because chameleons are delicate animals and often hide illness very well. Every single time I bring my chameleon, Little, to see Dr. Henry, I leave feeling reassured, informed, and genuinely cared for. She takes her time during appointments, asks thoughtful questions, explains things thoroughly, and never makes me feel rushed or dismissed.

One thing that especially stands out to me is how gently and confidently she handles Little throughout the visit. She is incredibly patient and attentive, and it is obvious how deeply she cares about reptiles and exotic animals. She has even shared stories about rehabilitating turtles in her free time, which says so much about the kind of person she is.

I also deeply appreciate how educational every visit is. Dr. Henry does not just give quick answers. She explains things in a way that helps me better understand my chameleon and become a better caretaker. That level of communication and compassion is rare.

Because of Dr. Henry, going to the vet no longer feels like a frightening experience. I trust her completely with Little’s care, and I am so grateful to have found a veterinarian who is this knowledgeable, compassionate, thorough, and passionate about animals.

Awesome care. Up to date knowledge. Pricing reasonable for the area. Experienced...but not afraid to refer to specialists if presented with something that is beyond their abilities. I like Vets that are pragmatic yet gentle in how difficult information is delivered.

Dr. Henry is the best! She was caring and thorough with my nervous girl, Abbey. Dr. Henry was able to answer many questions and concerns I had and provide with the most cost effective solution for her allergies.  The techs are also very sweet and patient with all the patients.
I cannot give North Suburbia enough kudos. I drive almost an hour to see them for any needs or concerns for my Buddy Jabba.
We appreciate the 5-star review, Mark! It's great to know you had a wonderful visit. We hope to welcome you and your pet back in the future!
Dr Henry has taken care of not only BUFFY(cat) but BENTLEY and Rex ( dogs). Dr Henry has always given thorough exams and not seems to fluster her.  Necessary for Stressed and scared animals

Thanks for always looking out for me and not just doing unnecessary thing.  My wallet appreciates it and I am so glad that I have found a competent doctor.  I have at least 10 vets closer to me but you are the ones I have learned to trust
Thanks for the top rating, Shane! We're happy to know you enjoyed your time with us. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!
The best most caring people I have ever met!

I truly cannot say enough phenomenal things about the staff at Suburbia Animal Hospital and Dr. Henry. My English Bulldog needed entropion surgery due to an eye ulcer, along with a tail amputation, and they were incredible every step of the way. From pre-op to post-op, the entire team was supportive, communicative, and genuinely caring throughout the whole process. The surgery was also affordable which helped us make the decision to go through with the surgery.

I also want to specifically mention Jenny, who has always been incredibly responsive and helpful through email.

I’m so thankful to say that his eye ulcer healed beautifully, and both his eye and tail amputation incisions healed extremely well. Knowing he was in such capable, compassionate hands made an overwhelming situation so much easier. We’re beyond grateful for this team.
The staff here is very friendly and helpful.  The ladies are so kind to my baby.  I really like them!
Great vets.  Weve been going here for 3 years.  They do our 2 dogs health certificates for international travel too.

❤️ ❤️ 🐶 🐶 🌟 What a Blessing so grateful for our Amazing Suburbia N Animal Hospital ❤️ Sharing such wonderful years as we have been with our Loving special family. "27" years. 🌟 🌟 🌟  🌟 🌟  Absolutely ❤️ 💙 💯

I have been coming to Suburbia since I adopted my first puppy in 2009 and haven't had a single regret.  Everyone there has been wonderful.  You can tell that they care deeply about the animals in their care and their owner.  I appreciate having a team I can trust with my four-legged babies.

I've been coming to you all for YEARS and still love you more to this day.  All my animals, past and present, thank you all!  Baby (passed), Whiskey (passed), Charlie (passed), Teddy (passed), Chloe, Cooper, Sophie, Honey, and Ozzy love(d) each and every one of you!

Staff extremely nice and Vet goes above and beyond...Taking her time you don't feel rushed..This is our first Frenchie and she explained everything gave suggestions even to insurance..I appreciate the kindness professionalism and most importantly I felt my lil boy was in the BESTEST OF HANDS
Thank you for the rating! We appreciate your trust in us and are always here to provide the best care for your furry family members 🐾😊 …
Well know for French bulldogs. They take all dogs and cats. Staff is very nice all around.  Great pup packages.

Amazing place, the whole staff are genuine kind and lovely people. They take such good care of every pet going in and out of the facility, and actually take the time and extra steps to make sure everything is fixed/going well with your pet.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. From the very first moment, the entire staff treated my dog ​​Luna with love, respect, and great professionalism.

I also appreciate their reasonable prices and transparency throughout the entire process.
I especially want to highlight Jessica for her dedication and the loving care she gave Luna, treating her like she was part of her own family. Without a doubt, a place you can trust.
Dr Smith is wonderful, and so is the staff.
Excellent care for all of my pets.
Hi Alex! Thank you so much for the stars. We are thrilled we get to have such wonderful clients like you!
I highly recommend it. Excellent service, very friendly staff, excellent cleanliness, and they take great care of pets.
Outstanding treatment!! We love this vet!!
Thank you for the rating! We appreciate your trust in us and are always here to provide the best care for your furry family members 🐾😊 …
Great place to go if you want your pets treated like family

I cannot stress enough how GREAT this vet is. The front staff are nice and personable. The doctors are cheerful and they listen to your needs. I called early one morning for an emergency and even though they were slammed in there. They told me to come on. They let me know costs, after care, talked to me about any issues and just made me feel better when about 7 other places turned me away

Thank you
Always provide good service. The only clinic i thrust regarding reproductives and  care of my dogs
Thank you for the rating! We appreciate your trust in us and are always here to provide the best care for your furry family members 🐾😊 …

They are amazing, I have taken my dogs there and the people show so much love to my dogs, Now I have Reba she is so spoiled with so much attention by them.  The prices are so comparable or even better then  other. So happy with the love they show my baby girl Reba.
I'm 30 miles from the clinic and this is where I choose to come.  I have a westie and I trust Dr. McGuire to keep her healthy.

If you’re looking for someone to FAIL epically at “screwing the pooch,” look no further — this is your vet!

A friend recommended Suburbia to give my dogs a little “hand,” with but after being charged $300 for two AI appointments, they blamed the inability to collect (anything besides my money) on the “inexperience” of my stud — rather than the "MOTION of THEIR ocean."

Now, I know my limits when it comes to my dogs (which is why I use professionals for this kind of thing). But I also know when something’s being rushed and done half-heartedly.

I’m not saying they needed Marvin Gaye crooning “Let’s Get It On” or candles in the exam room. They just need to know how to finish what they started and need to work on their technique (just not on a male that you REALLY want a litter from).— To be honest, at this point, it's almost easier to believe that they sabotaged the appointment rather than have this level of incompetence.

Suburbia left me not only doubting my male’s abilities but I found myself scrambling to find someone who could actually get the "job" done.

Enter: Johnathan the Collector (yes, that’s his real contact card sent to me). WHAM–BAM–THANK YOU, MAMM! With in 5 min, the deed was done, and my boy was practically lighting a cigarette. That proved beyond doubt that my stud had what it takes — Suburbia just didn’t.

I’m not saying Suburbia is a terrible vet, I am SURE they have wonderful skills (which is why they got 2🌟)… I’m just saying they might want to stick to neutering — seems more their speed.

One more thing, I generally give positive reviews but considering the exact timing breeding takes and massive expenses breeding with vets involves, you need someone who you can trust. Two days in the hands of a inexperienced vet can make or break a litter and your wallet.
They are so very friendly and loving to my fur baby
Thank you for the paw-some rating, donna!
They are amazing people. Can't thank you enough for keeping our puppy safe and didn't gave up on the calls and text messages to let us know he was missing.

what wonderful doctors and  staff I have been comming here  for along time, I am so greatful for this vets office for everything  they have done over the years for my fur babies,  they always  go above and beyond,  thanks  Suburbia  animal hospital ❤️

We love your team! Everyone is so kind and caring. Our kitty Shadow is never nervous or stressed when we visit. We have been bringing him in since we rescued him about three years ago. They took care of his dental issues and an injury and all vaccinations. They never push unnecessary procedures or products but I trust them to do what’s needed. We have seen several of the veterinarians there and all have been great!
Hi Beverlye! Thank you so much for the stars. We are thrilled we get to have such wonderful clients like you!

I can’t thank this vet office enough! My cat was poisoned, and as soon as they opened, I called in a panic—they got me in right away. The woman at the front desk with the long black ponytail was incredibly kind and reassuring during such a stressful moment. The vet tech was just as compassionate and helpful. The blonde-haired veterinarian was amazing—so knowledgeable and caring. Thanks to their fast action and incredible care, my cat was already feeling better by the end of the day. I’m beyond grateful for this team. Highly recommend!

This animal hospital truly deserves these ratings. Sarah at the front desk deserves a raise!! She was extremely kind and helpful! 🥰 Our experience with this vet has been nothing but the best. Highly recommend!!! …

My husband, Ginger and Me are so incredibly grateful for everything they have done. Their kindness, compassion, and professionalism truly mean the world to us. They were amazing every step of the way and took such wonderful care of Ginger. It gave us so much peace of mind knowing he was in their capable and loving hands. We can’t thank them enough for all the care and support they provided. They truly are an exceptional team. I really want to thank to Dr. Feng and Jessica for being there for me and Ginger and for taking such a good care of him and for all the love they give him. They are the best. Now Ginger is finally back to normal and being such a happy kitty.❤️

Get your USDA certified Rabies Certificate form,  required by the CDC for international travel, here.  The CDC changed the law for whats required for returning to the USA after international travel.  They are caring and service both our dogs.

I brought in my 10 year old chihuahua for a comprehensive checkup .He was thoroughly examined had some X-rays and lab work done. He is familiar with everyone there and knows Dr Macguire.  She is very thorough and well respected amongst her peers. We would not go anywhere but Suburbia.
10/10 care, compassion and knowledge. Would recommend every time.
I recently got a new puppy & was recommended this office. I’m so glad i went with the recommendation the staff is super friendly & caring. I feel really confident bringing my fur baby Nori here.

Suburbia Vet has always been the best. My English bulldog- Bentley truly loved going there, and that says everything about how kind and caring they are. They took such amazing care of him throughout his life. They’ve always been great, and I fully trust them with the rest of my family especially our other English bulldog Finn.

Finn, and our two cats Queso, and Sumi are just as comfortable and happy there as Bentley was, which gives me so much peace of mind.

Thank you, Suburbia Vet, for the consistent care and for treating my pets like family. You’ve always been wonderful, and we’re lucky to have you! 💙🐾
